Method of Attack: Includes a renamed Chrome Password Dump tool that extracts passwords from Chrome's internal database
Password dumper activates only when pirated license keys are used to activate the mod
Acts as a DRM targeting pirate copies by collecting password data from users' computers without consent
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Flight Simulator X with A320-X mod
Attack Vector: Bundled inside the mod installer for A320-X add-on
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of test.exe file (renamed Chrome Password Dump tool)
Pirate serial numbers used to activate the mod triggering the password dumper
